BUSINESS STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Trial Balance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Trial Balance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Trial Balance never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Trial Balance as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Trial Balance.

2. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   B. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   D. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

4. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   B. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

6. Which statement about The Ledger is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Ledger never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing The Ledger.
   C. Explain The Ledger with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat The Ledger as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Methods of Price Determination is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Methods of Price Determination never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Methods of Price Determination.
   C. Explain Methods of Price Determination with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Methods of Price Determination as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Savings and Investments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Savings and Investments.
   B. Explain Savings and Investments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Savings and Investments as rumours only.
   D. Say Savings and Investments never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Financial Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Financial Markets as rumours only.
   B. Say Financial Markets never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Financial Markets.
   D. Explain Financial Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   C. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.

11. Which statement about Procurement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Procurement as rumours only.
   B. Explain Procurement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Procurement never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Procurement.

12. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.

13. Which statement about Consumer and Investor Protection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Consumer and Investor Protection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Consumer and Investor Protection.
   C. Treat Consumer and Investor Protection as rumours only.
   D. Say Consumer and Investor Protection never happens in Kenya.

14. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Kisumu
   D. Mombasa

15. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Ignore prices in shops

16. Which statement about Cash Books is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Cash Books as rumours only.
   B. Explain Cash Books with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Books.
   D. Say Cash Books never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Economic Planning and Development in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain International Trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Business Ownership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Methods of Price Determination and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Procurement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Marketing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain The Ledger and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
